rules.content:
title: Scam Merchant High-Velocity Transaction Pattern
status: experimental
description: Detects merchant accounts exhibiting high initial transaction velocity, elevated chargeback ratios, and short account age — a pattern consistent with purchase scam merchant operations. Recorded Future
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: merchant_monitoring
detection:
    selection_velocity:
        merchant_account_age_days|lte: 90
        daily_transaction_count|gte: 200
    selection_chargeback:
        merchant_account_age_days|lte: 90
        chargeback_ratio_pct|gte: 1.5
    selection_combined:
        merchant_account_age_days|lte: 30
        daily_transaction_count|gte: 100
        unique_cards_per_day|gte: 80
        chargeback_ratio_pct|gte: 0.8
    condition: selection_velocity or selection_chargeback or selection_combined
level: high
rules.title: DL-0078: Scam Merchant High-Velocity Transaction Pattern (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Subscription Trap Billing Pattern Detection
status: experimental
description: Detects recurring billing patterns characteristic of subscription trap scam merchants, where initial low-value trial charges are followed by significantly higher recurring charges to merchants with el
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: transaction_monitoring
detection:
    selection:
        billing_type: "recurring"
        merchant_account_age_days|lte: 180
    filter_amount_disparity:
        initial_charge_amount|lte: 10.0
        subsequent_charge_amount|gte: 50.0
    filter_recurring_ratio:
        recurring_transaction_pct|gte: 30
    filter_dispute_rate:
        merchant_dispute_rate_pct|gte: 2.0
    condition: selection and filter_amount_disparity and filter_recurring_ratio and filter_dispute_rate
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0079: Subscription Trap Billing Pattern Detection (Sigma)
